mathematical_check.simplicial_identities: The stated face and degeneracy identities are the standard simplicial identities, with rightmost map applied first. Pullback reverses their arrow directions and induces the cosimplicial cochain maps; the alternating face sum squares to zero by the face identities. Degeneracies are structure maps of the simplicial object, not additional terms in the displayed normalized or unnormalized E₁ description.
mathematical_check.domains_codomain: The augmentation is Y₀→Y; faces lower simplicial degree and degeneracies raise it. On cohomology, face pullbacks raise p by one, so the E₁ differential is d₁:E₁^{p,q}→E₁^{p+1,q}.
mathematical_check.total_degree: The abutment is H^{p+q}(Y;Q), not H^{q−p}; diagonal p+q=n is finite by [F2]. The simple complex has total degree p+q.
mathematical_check.weight_bound: The [F3] identification uses E₂^{n−q,q} with first index p=n−q≥0, hence q≤n. No mismatch found in the item’s stated indexing or weight bound.
mathematical_check.result: No mathematical defect found in the face/degeneracy or total-degree indexing claims. A diagram should label the augmentation and bidegrees explicitly; the identities themselves remain prose or a caption.
